bullets.text: Flexible Work Expectations Updated - **Microsoft** sets new in-office requirements to three days a week for employees.
AI Actions in File Explorer - New **Windows 11** build introduces AI features for enhanced file management.
Mandatory MFA Enforcement - **Azure** begins Phase 2 of multifactor authentication to enhance security starting October 2025.
Interop 2026 Proposals Open - **Microsoft** invites submissions to enhance web interoperability for developers.
Cost Management Updates - **Microsoft** enhances tools for better financial oversight and cost optimization.
